words.zhGloss: 给对方留出拒绝的余地
words.enDefinition: to make a request in a way that allows the other person to say no comfortably
acceptedZhAnswers: 给对方留出拒绝的余地
acceptedEnVariants: leave someone room to decline

examples.en: The tutor asked us to leave someone room to decline when inviting them to speak.
examples.zh: 辅导老师提醒我们，邀请别人发言时要「给对方留出拒绝的余地」。

examples.en: A private invitation can leave someone room to decline without explaining themselves to the group.
examples.zh: 私下邀请能「给对方留出拒绝的余地」，对方不用当着大家解释。

collocations: leave someone room to decline an invitation
leave someone room to decline without explanation
always leave someone room to decline

words.expression: reiterate a refusal
words.lemma: reiterate a refusal
words.enDefinition: to state a refusal again, typically after a repeated request
acceptedEnVariants: reiterate a refusal

examples.en: After the second email, the student had to reiterate a refusal she had already made in person.
examples.zh: 收到第二封邮件后，那名学生不得不「再次拒绝」，她之前已经当面说过不。

examples.en: She chose to reiterate a refusal in writing so the committee would stop calling her.
examples.zh: 她决定以书面形式「重申拒绝」，好让委员会别再打电话。

collocations: reiterate a refusal in writing
calmly reiterate a refusal
reiterate a refusal to take part

words.expression: I'll text before coming over next time
words.lemma: i'll text before coming over next time
words.zhGloss: 下次过来之前我会先发消息
words.enDefinition: a promise to give advance notice after someone sets a limit on unexpected visits
acceptedZhAnswers: 下次过来之前我会先发消息
acceptedEnVariants: I'll text before coming over next time

examples.en: “I'll text before coming over next time,” I told my neighbor after interrupting her rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我打断了邻居的排练后，告诉她：“「下次过来之前我会先发消息」。”

examples.en: When my cousin asked for more notice, I said, “I'll text before coming over next time.”
examples.zh: 表姐请我早点打招呼，我说：“「下次过来之前我会先发消息」。”

collocations: sure, I'll text before coming over next time
I promise I'll text before coming over next time
I'll text before coming over next time and wait for a reply

words.expression: I'll ask before I share it
words.lemma: i'll ask before i share it
words.enDefinition: a promise to get permission before sending something to other people
acceptedEnVariants: I'll ask before I share it

examples.en: “I'll ask before I share it,” I told Maya after she showed me her recording.
examples.zh: 玛雅给我看了她的录音后，我说：“「分享之前我会先问你」。”

examples.en: When the student sent me her draft, I wrote back, “I'll ask before I share it.”
examples.zh: 那位同学把初稿发给我时，我回道：“「分享之前我会先问你」。”

collocations: of course I'll ask before I share it
I promise I'll ask before I share it
I'll ask before I share it with the group
